# @arki/contracts

> Shared Zod schemas for arki apps: prefixed ids, keyset pagination, Drizzle-derived branded schemas, and one typed identity per oRPC contract procedure. It is not a database layer and not a replacement for Zod.

Match errors on `error.code`, never on the message. The main entry never loads Drizzle or oRPC.

## Import paths

<!-- llms:start -->
- `@arki/contracts`: Browser-safe schema tools: Zod, form data, prefixed ids, keyset pagination and coded errors. `$brand`, `$input`, `$output`, `CONTRACTS_ERROR_CODES`, `CURSOR_DECODE_FAILURES`, `CURSOR_ENCODE_FAILURES`, `CURSOR_FAILURES`, `ContractsError`, `ID_GENERATION_FAILURES`, `INVALID`, `InvalidCursor`, `InvalidCursorValue`; and 319 more.
- `@arki/contracts/drizzle`: Runtime-backed select, insert and update schemas built from a Drizzle table. `COLUMN_ZOD_SCHEMA`, `bufferSchema`, `createInsertSchema`, `createSchemaFactory`, `createSelectSchema`, `createUpdateSchema`, `jsonColumn`, `jsonSchema`, `literalSchema`.
- `@arki/contracts/orpc`: Operations: one typed identity per contract procedure. `OPERATION`, `operationAt`, `operationOf`, `operations`; types `AnyOperation`, `ErrorOf`, `Identified`, `InputOf`, `MetaOf`, `Operation`, `OperationOf`, `Operations`; and 1 more.
<!-- llms:end -->

## Rules that bite

- Policy goes on the contract, once. Never restate it on the client.
- `name === path.join('.')`: the same string the server stores as `procedure_path`.
- A contract key may not contain `.` or be a reserved query-utils name. `operations()` throws.
- End a keyset on a unique key and order by NOT NULL columns.
- A cursor only works with the keyset that made it. It is opaque, not secret.
- `defineId().create()` returns ID | IdGenerationFailure; check `isFailure`. `ID_GENERATION_FAILURES` declares RandomSourceUnavailable / UnexpectedDefect. UUID generation prefers randomUUID, falling back to secure getRandomValues bytes. Applications without Web Crypto own provider initialization and must require secure platform entropy or fail closed in every supported mode; Contracts cannot certify entropy quality from output.
- No two id prefixes in one app may be equal or start one another. Call `assertUniqueIdPrefixes` in a test.
